units.source_text: 这回，她的眼睛里噙满了兴奋的喜悦的泪水。

en.t: This time, her eyes brimmed with tears of excited joy.

units.source_text: 她忘却了方才的屈辱，相反地投身在往事的回忆里，

en.t: She forgot the humiliation she had just suffered and instead threw herself into memories of the past,

units.source_text: 使同样的兴奋的延续转移到另一种兴奋中，

en.t: letting the same continuing excitement shift into another kind of excitement,
until it was almost close to madness.

units.source_text: 她的藤架霞花纹和服的下摆凌乱了。

en.t: The hem of her kimono, patterned with wisteria trellises and mist, had fallen into disarray.
